meta.title: Pakistan to Qatar Nursing Master Plan
meta.subtitle: ❤️ حسن گل بھائی کی طرف سے اپنی بہن کے لیے
meta.disclaimer: یہ روڈ میپ عمومی رہنمائی کے لیے ہے۔ حتمی فیصلوں کے لیے ہمیشہ DHP کی آفیشل ویب سائٹ (dhp.moph.gov.qa) اور اپنے ریکروٹمنٹ ایجنسی سے تازہ ترین معلومات کی تصدیق کریں۔

stages.title: Eligibility Check & Documents
stages.description: Confirm your nursing qualification and gather every document DHP will ask for later, before any portal work begins.
checklist: Pakistan Nursing Council (PNC) registration is active
Recognized nursing diploma/degree — original + attested transcripts
Experience certificates from every previous employer

stages.title: DataFlow Verification (PSV)
stages.description: DataFlow performs Primary Source Verification (PSV) of your education, license and experience directly with the issuing institutions. As of Jan 2026 this step is mandatory for every applicant, no exceptions.
checklist: Create a DataFlow account and open a case
Submit education, license and experience documents
Track case until PSV report is issued

stages.title: DHP Account & Eligibility ID
stages.titleUr: DHP اکاؤنٹ اور اہلیت آئی ڈی
stages.description: Register on the Sheryan/DHP e-registration portal (the system many still call QCHP) and submit your documents to receive an eligibility ID — this unlocks Prometric booking.
checklist: Upload PSV report and supporting documents

stages.title: Prometric Exam (or Exemption)
stages.description: Sit the Qatar Prometric qualifying exam, or apply for an exemption if you hold a recognized qualifying exam already — exemptions must now be backed by a PSV report too. A passed qualifying exam is typically valid for 3 years.
checklist: Register and pay the Prometric exam fee
Study core topics: medical-surgical, cardiovascular, renal/urinary, wound care
Book test center and sit the exam
If exempt: confirm PSV-supported exemption is accepted

stages.title: Evaluation Application
stages.description: With PSV and exam results in hand, submit the preliminary Evaluation application through the DHP portal.

stages.title: Job Offer & Sponsorship
stages.description: Apply to Qatar healthcare employers (public hospitals like Hamad Medical Corporation, or private facilities). Final licensing is tied to an employer's sponsorship.
checklist: Build/update CV for Qatar healthcare employers
Apply directly or through a licensed recruitment agency
Receive and review signed job offer letter

stages.title: Final Licensing & Registration
stages.description: Once evaluation is approved and an employer sponsors you, DHP issues the official license and registration number to practice in Qatar.
checklist: Employer confirms sponsorship in the DHP portal
Receive official license certificate and number

stages.title: Visa, Medical Exam & Relocation
stages.titleUr: ویزا، طبی معائنہ اور نقل مکانی
stages.description: Employer processes the Qatar work visa. Complete the medical fitness test and arrange travel. The full journey from PSV to arrival commonly takes 3-6 months in total.

stages.title: Arrival & Orientation
stages.description: On arrival, complete local formalities and hospital induction — the final stamp before starting work as a licensed nurse in Qatar.
checklist: Begin work as a registered nurse in Qatar 🎉
